errors.evidence: For the blue dashed line (MEMIT Efficacy_top), the description reports a final value of 5 at 3000 edits. The plot shows this value is approximately 25 on the left y-axis.
For the red solid line (AlphaEdit noise_E), the description reports a starting value of 28. The plot shows this value is approximately 10 on the correct right y-axis (noise_E).

For the red solid line (AlphaEdit noise_E), the description reports an ending value of 30. This value is incorrectly read from the left y-axis (Efficacy_top). The correct value on the right y-axis (noise_E) is approximately 12.

For the blue solid line (MEMIT noise_E), the description reports a starting value of 30. This value is incorrectly read from the left y-axis (Efficacy_top). The correct value on the right y-axis (noise_E) is approximately 27.
